newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran denies charges it behind Baghdad attack.
newsitem.headline: Iran denies charges it behind Baghdad attack.

text.p: Iran has denied charges by Iraq that it was behind a mortar bomb attack on the Baghdad headquarters of an Iranian opposition group.

A Foreign Ministry spokesman told the official Iranian news agency IRNA late on Wednesday that the charges were baseless and "merely aimed at distracting the public opinion from Iraq's internal problems".
He said "linking internal problems...to foreign elements was an old, useless and tired propaganda attempt" by Iraq.

Iraq said on Wednesday that Iran was to blame for three mortar bombs fired on Tuesday night at the Baghdad headquarters of the Iranian opposition group Mujahideen Khalq, killing one person and wounding several.
The Mujahideen Khalq has military bases close to the border with Iran and has vowed to topple Tehran's government. It also blamed Tehran for the attack and said it would retaliate.
